hypothesis.statement: P35 could not be executed truthfully because the production resolver exposed only bilateral blink and no immutable Editor state machine applied, observed and captured each semantic sample.
hypothesis.action: Add a shared explicit-semantic resolver with asymmetric blink support, expose it to UE Python, apply resolved direct morphs to the real face component, read them back, and capture all 57 samples through a tick-driven fail-closed runner.
hypothesis.expectedResult: A real UE 5.6 session can generate lineage-bound curve traces and Looking Glass Go captures without bypassing production mapping logic.

implementation.execution: interactive UE 5.6 Slate post-tick state machine
implementation.outputPolicy: new output root only; per-sample PNG and trace SHA-256; failure receipt on abort

scopeBoundary: Control Rig curve execution fails closed until a concrete animation-bridge executor exists
high-resolution screenshot capture is a fixed Go evidence path, not quilt calibration proof
P12 geometry diagnostics and human expression review remain mandatory
failureHandling: reject ambiguous actor, face component or camera lookup
reject P34 or P35 checksum drift and existing output directory
reject unimplemented Control Rig curve execution
reject applied versus observed morph mismatch and 120-second capture timeout
write failure.json and never emit candidate evidence after an incomplete run
decision: Use P36 to create P35 evidence only after the real MetaHuman, profile, fixed Go camera and MRQ preset exist.
